title: Microsoft and Salesforce Launch Copilotforce at Ignite
summary: Microsoft and Salesforce announce Copilotforce partnership at Ignite conference
detailed: Microsoft and Salesforce are bringing Salesforce into Copilot with Copilotforce, a new plugin in public preview with 38+ sales skills, plus Sales Cloud in Teams in pilot and a two-way Zero Copy data link between Salesforce Data 360 and Microsoft Fabric.
Accenture is the first pilot customer.
